elements.label: Zendesk logomark (glyph row collapses into the Z mark)

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Percussive music beat ~330 ms before the collapse; part of the rhythmic bed, not a designed SFX.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Beat ~120 ms before the collapse; same broadband streak pattern as the surrounding music hits.

pattern.description: The wide glyph row (Z half, chat bubble, checkmark circle, K half) collapses inward: bubble and check shrink/morph away so the two halves meet as the Zendesk Z mark, which then rises while the 'zendesk' wordmark fades and slides up beneath it into the final lockup.
pattern.why_premium: The product's own icons (chat, resolved check) physically fold into the brand mark, tying the story to the logo; a fast collapse followed by a softer wordmark ease-out gives a punchy-then-settled two-beat resolve.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(['.bubble','.check'], {scale: 0, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power2.in'}).to('.zLeft', {x: '+=offset', duration: 0.1, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<').to('.kRight', {x: '-=offset', duration: 0.1, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<').to('.mark', {y: -40, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}, '+=0.2').fromTo('.wordmark', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 30}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<');
build_hint.remotion: Collapse: interpolate(frame, [0, 3], [1, 0], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}) on bubble/check scale and glyph translateX. Lockup at ~frame 11: spring({frame: frame - 11, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 170, mass: 1}}) driving mark translateY and wordmark opacity/translateY (no overshoot).

notes: Two energy peaks: the collapse (frames ~3474-3475) and the lockup rise plus wordmark entrance (~3485-3491). b01 (union) and b04 (OCR padding of the wordmark) omitted as duplicates of b02/b03.
